instruction: Change the title font color on slide 2 to black.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-slide, single-property task (color only on slide 2) within the model's demonstrated capability of changing font colors
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title font color on slide 2 to black. Getter extracts the title shape (largest font) from slide 2 and returns its color. Metric checks all title runs have color 000000.
